Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Record Class BigDataUtils.DatasetInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sc.fiji.snt.util.BigDataUtils.DatasetInfo
Record Components:
name - display name
nChannels - number of channels
nTimepoints - number of timepoints
unit - spatial unit, or null if unknown
remote - whether the dataset is read over the network
chunkShape - chunk shape of the full resolution array {x, y, z[, c, t]}, or null
levels - the resolution levels, from full resolution to coarsest
Enclosing class:
BigDataUtils
public static record BigDataUtils.DatasetInfo(String name, int nChannels, int nTimepoints, String unit, boolean remote, int[] chunkShape, List<BigDataUtils.LevelInfo> levels) extends Record
Summary of a dataset, as returned by BigDataUtils.describe(java.lang.String).
